newsitem.title: USA: ADC Telecommunications sees higher Q3 revs.
newsitem.headline: ADC Telecommunications sees higher Q3 revs.

text.p: ADC Telecommunications Inc said Wednesday it expects to generate revenues of $292 million for its fiscal third quarter ended July 31, 1997, a 35 percent increase over $217 million in revenues in the same quarter a year ago.
These estimated revenues represent a new quarterly revenue record for the company. Acquired companies contributed about $19 million of the total.

For the nine months ended July 31, 1997, ADC estimated revenues of $828 million, up 45 percent increase over the $573 million of revenues recorded for the nine months ended July 31, 1996. The revenue contribution from acquired companies is estimated at about $90 million.
Final results for third quarter 1997 will be announced in late August.
ADC designs, makes and markets transmission and networking systems and broadband connectivity products for fiber optic, and coaxial and wireless broadband global networks.
